crime: Every evening at free time, her roommate called the prisoners out to the courtyard for hide-and-seek, and no one ever found her.
Every night in their cell, {WITCH_NAME} asked her out loud, "Will you still want me tomorrow?" All day long she had heard the roommate's fond thoughts whispered at her ear, and still she asked.
One evening in the dining hall, the roommate laughed and announced, "For one week I'm hiding from you. I won't think of you once."
Long ago, a foster mother had put her things in a pillowcase and said, "Let's try one more week." At the end of that week, she was sent back.
Later that evening, in the lounge, she heard her roommate's voice whisper at her ear. It was the first time all evening the roommate had thought of her: "She'll never look for me in the guest house."
She went to the guest house. She did not call out "Found you." She struck her roommate from behind with a stone until the girl stopped moving.
Then, until lights-out, she went from room to room asking everyone, "Have you seen her?"
In the trial court, the prisoners ruled her out. She had spent the whole evening asking where her roommate was; she never knew where to look, so the guest house had been beyond her reach.
Then one prisoner remembered what the roommate had said at dinner: she would hide in the one place {WITCH_NAME} would never think to look. To choose that place, the roommate had to think of her.
The prisoners understood. Every thought of that hiding place had reached her ear. Of everyone in the mansion, only she had known where to go.
fields.epitaph: Even while hiding from her, her roommate never once stopped thinking of her.
fields.epithet: The Girl Kept One More Week at a Time
execution: The execution stand in the trial court holds an iron wardrobe. It shuts her inside, standing, with a grille level with her eyes.
Sand pours over her head and begins to rise. Her fingers hook through the grille.
The sand climbs until it spills out between the bars. Her fingers go still.
The stand lowers the wardrobe through the floor, and the floor closes over it, in a place where no one will look.

magic.name: Thinking of You
magic.text: She hears every thought anyone has about her, whispered at her ear in their own voice.
